intuition.title: Study context: Preparation variations
intuition.text: Table I retains dilution, temperature, pH and ultrasonic yes/no distinctions. The last preparation sprays lead-nitrate solution into an H2S chamber with continuous recycling. No missing gas dose or fixed-pH reagent is reconstructed.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Preparation paragraph; Table I

intuition.title: Study context: Unresolved sample mapping
intuition.text: Figure 1 and Figure 2/text identify pH 12; Table I instead prints pH 14 for its 12.9 nm row. Table II gives specimen 1 XRD size 12.9 nm. Equal size is not sufficient to resolve this pH or batch-assignment discrepancy; microscopy/electrical specimens remain separate supporting contexts.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Figure 1, Figure 2, Tables I–II

intuition.title: Study context: Technique-specific sizes
intuition.text: Table II compares log-normal TEM medians with X-ray line-broadening sizes; geometric standard deviation is dimensionless. The source reports larger XRD values. Numbered electrical specimens remain distinct from preparation rows.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Tables I–II and TEM discussion

intuition.title: Study context: Electrical interpretation
intuition.text: High-temperature slopes yield band-gap estimates; low-temperature slopes below 170 K are attributed to electron tunnelling. Predicted gaps and model-inverted diameters/separations are theory-derived; they are not additional imaged particle measurements.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3, Equations 2–3; Table III; Figure 4

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
